body:
Close issue #241 Cursor P5 independence gap. T47 / ADR-0006 / cursor-native-parity assumed Cursor had no subagent fan-out; Cursor now documents plugin `agents/` and Agent Task/subagents. Ship a prosecutor agent roster and rewrite `/adlc-prosecute` to fan lenses across fresh contexts, keeping sequential fallback + cross-model `adversarial-review --providers`.

=== CONTRACT ===
Per `.adlc/specs/cursor-deeper-native.md` (must exist from T64 or be authored/updated here if missing): port Claude Code prosecutor agents into Cursor agent markdown frontmatter (`name`, `description`; Cursor-valid tools list — do not copy Claude-only tool IDs blindly). Register `agents` in plugin.json. `/adlc-prosecute` must instruct Task (or Cursor agent invocation) fan-out for the five lenses + verifier; must NOT claim "Cursor has no subagent fan-out". Independence caveat becomes: prefer fresh-context agents; sequential same-context is degraded fallback only.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
CURSOR AGENT FRONTMATTER: every lens + verifier agent MUST set `readonly: true` (Cursor subagent field; see cursor.com/docs/subagents). Do NOT copy Claude Code `tools:` frontmatter — it is not Cursor syntax and does not enforce read-only. Optional `prosecutor.md` orchestrator may use `readonly: false` only if it must run mechanical shell gates; document why. Packaging/smoke MUST reject lens/verifier agents missing `readonly: true`.
1. `plugins/adlc-cursor/agents/` with at least the five lens agents + verifier (+ optional orchestrator prosecutor.md), adapted from plugins/adlc-claude-code/agents/.
2. plugin.json `agents` path; package files allowlist.
3. Rewrite command/adlc-prosecute.md for Task/agent fan-out; keep recording via gate-manifest / adlc_prosecute MCP when available.
4. Update skills/adlc SKILL.md P5 section and smoke caveat assertions (replace old "no subagent" strings).
5. Matrix + docs: Cursor P5 independence cell moves from sequential-only to agents-backed (still note cross-model providers for risk gate).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: agents/ directory has ≥5 lens agents + verifier with valid frontmatter including `readonly: true` on every lens and verifier. VERIFY: packaging + smoke reject missing readonly.
- AC2: `/adlc-prosecute` body describes Task/fresh-context fan-out and does NOT contain the exact stale claim that Cursor has no subagent fan-out. VERIFY: smoke string asserts.
- AC3: Sequential fallback still documented for hosts without Task. VERIFY: command body + smoke.
- AC4: Still recommends `npx adversarial-review --providers` for cross-model risk gate. VERIFY: smoke.
- AC5: Does not modify packages/core/lib/prosecutor.mjs convergence semantics (rails) — orchestration only.
- AC6: cursor-install-smoke + plugin tests pass.

=== OUT OF SCOPE ===
- subagentStart/Stop hook orchestration (T67).
- Live deny-proof (T68).
- Changing hollow-test / behavior-diff CLIs.
=== P1 CONTRACT AMENDMENTS (binding via umbrella spec) ===
AC9/AC10 require the exact five-lens + verifier roster packaged with
readonly:true; /adlc-prosecute must require fresh-context fan-out, fail-closed
verifier, @adlc/core convergence, and ticket-/revision-bound prosecution
evidence via adlc prosecute / adlc_prosecute. Prose-only Task mention fails.
